title: Hold the gift without gripping it
summary: The line loosens the hand without asking the heart to go cold. Do not let the day outrun this: keep this in front of you: steadiness grows where attachment loses its authority.
takeaway: Let love stay tender without tightening into possession.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: Love is steadied by release, not possession.
source.lifeApplication: When the hand tightens, loosen it and receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
